RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 8, 2006/Phalguna 17, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
ASEAN-India Summit
*241. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what follow-up action Government
have taken so far after the Fourth ASEAN-
India Summit held in December 2005 which
was attended by the Prime Minister of
India;
(b) whether there was any headway
towards opening of more gateways along
the Indo-Myanmar Border to facilitate
development of the North Eatsern Region;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if reply to part (b) above be in the
negative, the reasons therefor?
Hoax call regarding bomb in
Parliament House
†*242. SHRI VASANT CHAVAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) whether an E-mail was received with
regard to the rumour of a bomb planted in
the Parliament House;
(b) if so, whether accused have been
caught; and
(c) the details of the terrorist
organization working behind the said
rumour/E-mail?
 Ratio of manufacturing sector to GDP
†*243. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the last
decade contribution of the manufacturing
sector to the Gross Domestic Product
remained between 15 per cent to 17 per
cent;
(b) if not, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that during
the current decade Government have fixed
a target to increase its contribution; and

76
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Guidelines for FDI in retail trade
†*244. SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have issued guidelines for FDI in retail trade
of 'single brand' products;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the companies which have filed their
applications with the Department of
Industrial Policy and Promotions (DIPP)
for prior approval with the names of
'brands'?
MIG-21 crashes
*245. SHRI PRASANTA CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of accidents/crashes met
by MIG-21 during the period 1999-2005,
year-wise; and
(b) the reasons for such accidents/
crashes?
Non-deposit of employer's EPF share
by contractors
*246. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of contractors do not deposit regularly/
properly the employer's share of EPF
contribution and as a result thereof, workers
are unable to get the benefits of their EPF
contributions;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the number of defaulting contractors and
the number of the affected contract workers
in each State; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
Uniform labour policy
†*247. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
 Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
needs a uniform labour policy acceptable
to all;
(b) if so, Governments' reaction thereto;
(c) whether it is also a fact that different
labour laws have been implemented by
different departments in the name of labour
reforms; and
(d) if so, the details of such departments
indicating the variation in labour laws
applicable therein?
Unorganised Sector Worker's Social
Security Scheme
*248. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of the
Unorganised Sector Worker's Social
Security Scheme launched by his Ministry
during 2004;
(b) how many members have been
enrolled under the said scheme and the
amount of contributions realized; and

77
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) how much expenditure has been
incurred so far for implementing the said
scheme?
Abolition of child Labour
*249. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating to abolish child labour in the
country within a time bound programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have received
any financial aid from the World Bank,
International Labour Organisation and
UNICEF for abolition of child labour; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and to what
extent these financial aids are found to be
helpful in achieving the goal?
Allocation for Indira Awaas Yojana
*250. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
SHRIMATI VANGA
GEETHA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have increased
allocation under Indira Awaas Yojana to
Rs. 2750 crores as against Rs. 2500 crores
in the last year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have targeted
14.41 lakh houses to be constructed in
2005-06;
(d) if so, the present status in this regard;
(e) whether Government have also
envisaged free power connections in the
IAY houses under Rajiv Gandhi Gramin
Vidyutikaran Yojana in collaboration with
Ministry of Power;
(f) if so, the details thereof;
(g) whether Government have also taken
initiatives for display of the permanent IAY
wait list in the villages; and
(h) if so, the details thereof?
Attack on NMDC, Hiroli
(Chhattisgarh) by Maoists
†*251. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that maoists had
killed many personnel of CISF and looted
weapons on the 7th February 2006 by
attacking a PSU, National Mineral
Development Corporation, Hiroli
(Chhattisgarh); and
(b) if so, the details of the measures
being taken by Government for security of
this area in future?
SEZ by Essar Steel at Hazira
*252. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS
KAUR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether M/S Essar Steel has
proposed to set up a Special Economic
Zone at Hazira in Gujarat;
(b) if so, the special features thereof;
(c) Government's response thereto; and
(d) the details of the SEZs being set up
by the private sector and the steps being
taken by Government to ensure a balanced
development of the country?

78
Fund for paper industry
*253. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether paper industry has
requested for a fund in line with the Textile
Upgradation Fund;
(b) if so, whether any decision has been
taken in this regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
De-mining of landmines and traps
*254. SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether landmines and booby traps
are laid in the paths, villages and fruit
orchids in Manipur resulting in loss of
human lives and live stock;
(b) if so, the number of people killed
during the uphill task of demining these
landmines and traps till date; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
Talks with ULFA and NDFB
*255. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is
stalemate in the peace process with United
Liberation Front of Assam (ULFA);
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that another
armed outfit namely, National Democratic
Front of Bodoland (NDFB) is already under
cease fire and expressed willingness for
negotiated settlement; and
(d) if so, by when the formal talks are
expected to take place?
Need to broadbase the Committee set
up for stamping and marking
*256. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that handloom
and powerloom sectors have no
representation in the committee formed by
the Textile Commissioner to finalize the
stamping and marking, despite contributing
90 per cent of fabrics manufactured in the
country;
(b) whether Government have received
any representation from the Merchant's
Chamber of Commerce to reconstitute the
said committee to make the same broad
based;
(c) if so, what action Government have
taken thereon; and
(d) if replies to parts (b) and (c) above
be in the negative, the reasons therefor?
Duty Entitlement Passbook benefits
for Titanium dioxide
*257. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the products of Titanium dioxide
for which the "duty entitlement passbook
benefits" is not existing and the industrial
establishment in Kerala which produces
such products;

79
(b) the quantity of Titanium dioxide
reutile grade exported during the current
year and the quantity exported during the
last year; and
(c) whether Government propose to
amend the policy and extend the benefit of
Duty Entitlement Passbook to the
Titanium dioxide reutile grade produced by
KMML in Kerala?
Filling of SC, ST and OBC vacancies
*258. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
any special drive for employment
exchanges to fill up the vacancies for SCs,
STs and OBCs in Government and PSUs;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Review of working of the MCD and
NDMC
†*259. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had reviewed the working of the Municipal
Corporation of Delhi and New Delhi
Municipal Council in the month of
February, 2006;
(b) if so, the sectors whose working
was discussed during the  course of said
review;
(c) whether the comments of various
courts that law be enforeced on all equally
were also discussed in the course of this
review; and
(d) if so, the followup decision taken
by Government?
Import of timber from Myanmar
*260. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a trade delegation from India
recently visited Myanmar to explore the
possibility of import of timber through
land-route;
(b) if so, the outcome thereof;
(c) whether the Free Trade Agreement
among the members of BIMST-EC (Bay
of Bengal Initiative for Multi Sectoral
Technical and Economic Co-operation) has
been finalized; and
(d) if not, by when it is likely to be
finalized?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the March 8, 2006/Phalguna 17, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
Tax holiday for EOUs
1626. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Export Oriented Unit
(EOU) have demanded that they also be
given a Tax holiday on par with SEZ's;
(b) if so, the specific demand in this
regard;
(c) Government's reaction thereto;
(d) what other steps Government would
take to create adequate incentives for EOU's
to meet their challenges in the international
market; and
(e) the steps proposed to increase the
incentives being given to the Export
Oriented Units in the country?
FTA with China
1627. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
China are going to have a Free Trade
Agreement ;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the apex
body of the Indian exporters FECO
supported the move with a rider to have a
negative list which should include items like
textiles, auto components, leather, etc.; and
(c) the progress of talks on the FTA
with China?
Grant of patents to inventions
1628. SHRI SANJAY RAUT : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of inventions, which have
been granted Patents by Government in
the field of energy and automobile sectors
since last two years; and
(b) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken for using such inventions for the all-
round development in energy and
automobile sectors in the country?
Priority to N.E. region for trade
1629. SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have accorded

369
priority to making its North Eastern region
as an important Economic link with the
BIMSTEC members, in anticipation that
the North Eastern States could become
India's link to BIMSTEC and to ASIAN
countries; and
(b) if so, whether Government have
formulated any strategy in this regard with
details thereof?
FDI in retail sector
1630. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have allowed
FDI in retail sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the various sectors/items in which
the FDI has been allowed; and
(d) the various steps taken to save the
small traders?
Subsidy on fuel for fishing
 vessels
1631. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Marine Products Export
Development Authority (MPEDA) has a
scheme to subsidise the prices of fuel oil
used in fishing vessels in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what was the extent of this subsidy
in 2003-04 given by MPEDA;
(d) whether there is proposal to expand
this scheme by MPEDA; and
(e) the steps proposed by MPEDA to
expand and simplify this scheme to
subsidise diesel and other fuel?
India's share in World Farm
Trade
1632. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
double India's share in World Farm Trade;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the amount of agro-exports of various
products for the last three years, year-wise,
item-wise and category-wise;
(c) whether there are any steps to index
the export potential of different agricultural
crops;
(d) if so, the details of such index
prepared for various crops as on date;
and
(e) the steps taken/to be taken as a
perspective of agricultural export
promotion policy to achieve the above
goal ?
Proposals under  IIUS
1633. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of the proposals
submitted by various State Governments
under Industrial Infrastructure
Upgradation Scheme, location-wise, State-
wise;
(b) the number of proposals cleared so
far State-wise, location-wise;
(c) the reasons for the delay in clearing
the remaining proposals; and
(d) the time by when these proposals
are likely to be cleared?

370
Financial assistance for cluster
development
1634. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY : Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Karnataka Government has
sought financial assistance for 5 projects
on cluster development;
(b) if so, which are the projects on
cluster development awaiting approval of
Government; and
(c) what is the present status of the
above proposal?
Assistance to leather industry for
water treatment facilities
1635. SHRI C. PERUMAL : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether leather industry has
requested for Rs. 100 crore assistance to
set up water treatment facilities at the
effluent treatment plants for small tanners;
(b) if so, whether any decision has been
taken in this regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Special Economic Zones
1636. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA : Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had framed India specific rules and
legislation for setting up Special Economic
Zones;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government  expects over Rs. 10,000 crores
into these Special Economic Zones; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Indo-Quebec bilateral trade
1637. SHRI B.J. P ANDA : W ill the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Quebec
(Canada) is keen to attract Indian
investment in their land;
(b) what is the current Indo-Quebec
bilateral trade;
(c) whether certain Indian companies
have shown interest in making investment
there;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) Government's action plan to give a
boost to the bilateral trade between the two
countries?
AEZ for grapes in Karnataka
1638. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY : Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Karnataka Government has
requested sanction of Agri-Export Zone
(AEZ) for Grapes involving a financial
implication of Rs. 1875.00 lakhs; and
(b) if so, what is the present position of
above proposal?
AEZ for lime and pomegranate in
Karnataka
1639. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY : Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) when  a proposal for
establishment of AEZ for lime and

371
pomegranate in Karnataka was received
by Government;
(b) whether the above proposal has been
cleared;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the present status of the above
proposal?
Merchandized exports
1640. SHRI B.J. PANDA :
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR :
SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has fixed $93 billion target for
merchandized exports;
(b) what is its present status and how
far has the export growth been regained
during the last three years;
(c) the action plan of Government to
give a further boost to these exports; and
(d) what is the position of Orissa in
this sector?
Protection of domestic industries
outside SEZ
1641. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA : Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that no provision
has been made in the SEZ Act for protection
of indigenous industries from the
competition of SEZ units, in so far as the
domestic market is concerned;
(b) whether it is also a fact that in the
absence of proper restriction on the
movement of SEZ products to the domestic
market, domestic industries outside the
SEZ continue to struggle to compete; and
(c) if answers to part (a) and (b) above
are in the affirmative what action
Government propose to take to protect
the domestic industries?
WTO Ministerial meet in Hong Kong
1642. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS
KAUR :
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a World Trade Organization
(WTO) Ministerial meet was held in Hong
Kong in December last;
(b) if so, the issues discussed and
decisions taken therein; and
(c) whether any policy guidelines were
adopted to protect the interests of the
farmers in small and developing countries
against the protectionist subsidies granted
by developed countries for promoting their
farmers' interest?
Grievances of SEZ developers
1643. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA : Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether some developers have
complained that the concept of single-
window clearance with regard to SEZ is
highly diluted and far from ideal, although
the Development Commissioner has been
given power, but he does not have full
jurisdiction and authorities such as sales
tax, provident fund, etc. to intervene in these
matters;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government propose
to take to remedy the situation?

372
Extension of advantages for units of
Software Technology Parks of India
1644. SHRI C. PERUMAL : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state whether
National Association of Software and
services companies have demanded
extension of advantages for units in
Software Technology Parks of India?
Ratification of SAFTA
1645. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS
KAUR : Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether all the member countries
have ratified South Asian Free Trade Area
and if not, which countries have not yet
ratified the same; and
(b) what steps have since been taken
by Government and other member countries
in pursuance of the terms of  the agreement?
Sustainable livelihood for small
farmers
1646. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA : Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any representation was
received from the group of farmers who
took part in a parallel “peoples camp” in
Hong Kong during the recent WTO
Ministerial meeting, seeking Government's
intervention to protect sustainable
livelihood for small farmers in the context
of the WTO negotiations;
(b) if so, the nature and extent of
protection sought for small farmers; and
(c) what is Government's reaction
thereto?
Expansion of Indian deep sea fishing
fleet
1647. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Marine Products Export
Development Authority has made any
recommendation to expand the Indian deep
sea fishing fleet;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how many deep sea fishing vessels
are required according to the Marine
Products Export Development Authority
to meet the requirements and exports;
(d) whether the Marine Products Export
Development Authority would fund some
of the purchase of such boats; and
(e) if so, the details  thereof?
Special assistance for development of
tea industry in Assam
1648. SHRI LALIT SURI : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
decided to give special assistance for the
development of tea industry in Assam;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the time-frame fixed for the purpose; and
(c) whether the industry would also be
required to contribute its own share for the
purpose in addition to the Government's
assistance and if so, to what extent?
FDI in townships in SEZs
1649. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 100 per cent
Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in

373
townships does not apply to projects
located in Special Economic Zones;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the extent of FDI available for
townships in SEZs?
Separate Tobacco Board for non-
Virginia tobacco
1650. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal to form
a separate Tobacco Board for non-Virginia
type of tobacco in the country;
(b) if so, the details of this proposal;
(c) whether Government are aware that
non-Virginia tobacco is an important crop
in many States like Andhra Pradesh,
Gujarat, etc.;
(d) whether any survey has been done
on the export potential of non-Virginia
tobacco and its potential; and
(e) the details of steps proposed to bring
the crop under active Government
supervision?
Increase in transaction cost of shrimp
to US market
1651. SHRI  A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether shrimp export market faces
major problems due to the huge increase in
transaction cost of shrimp to US market
and the adverse climatic conditions to stock
shrimp seeds in farms;
(b) if so, the steps taken to resolve the
above problems as on date; and
(c) the total export of shrimp to various
countries and the foreign exchange received
for the last three years, country-wise and
category-wise?
Private investment in heavy
industries
1652. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH : Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
such heavy industries wherein the private
sector investment is likely to be allowed in
the near future;
(b) whether any of industries are located
in Andhra Pradesh;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the funds likely to be invested by
the private sector therein?
Strategies adopted at Valetta, Malta to
protect farmers' interests
1653. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS KAUR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of the fact that in
most of the developing Commonwealth
countries including India over 60 per cent
of the people depend on agriculture for their
livelihood, a strategy was evolved at the
recent meeting of the Commonwealth
countries a Valetta in Malta, to provide for
livelihood security for the farmers by
removing distortions in international trade
rules under the WTO regime, which are
created by developed countries through
huge domestic support and export subsidies
to protect their farmers;
(b) if so, the details of such strategy;
and

374
(c) the steps taken and being taken by
Government in the light of this strategy?
 Affairs of CMC
1654. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Spices Board, in the
month of February, 2006, asked the
Cardamom Marketing Corporation (CMC)
at Vadanmedu, Idukki district, Kerala not
to conduct any Cardamom auction;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
